name: jiminy-stitch-studio-agent-mcp
description: Current embroidery guides and WebMCP documentation via read-only public MCP.

interface.longDescription: Jiminy Stitch Studio Agent retrieves current public embroidery guidance, guide versions and WebMCP command documentation through an anonymous read-only MCP server. Bundled skills help plan satin, tatami, running and fur stitches, inspect designs and explain project recovery and export checks. The MCP exposes only get_jiminy_guide_catalog and get_jiminy_guide. It accepts public topic names and does not receive artwork, project data, browser identifiers or private account information. It does not control a browser or generate embroidery files. Actual artwork creation, Studio editing, previews and file delivery depend on the host tools available. If live guidance cannot be retrieved, the bundled guide snapshot is used and the limitation is disclosed. Guide retrieval does not automatically replace installed skills. Machine compatibility and successful sewing are not guaranteed; trial sewing is required.

浮世絵風富士山を画像生成から刺繍・確認・出力まで。 / Create ukiyo-e Mt Fuji art and embroidery; check the preview; export JEF/PES/JIMINY.

publication.release_notes: 1.2.4: Set the public display name to Jiminy Stitch Studio Agent. Retain the English bear, Japanese dog and bilingual Mount Fuji production prompts, public-guide MCP connection and existing production rules.

ja-JP.subtitle: 刺繍の制作スキルと最新ガイド
ja-JP.description: 最新版の刺繍制作ガイド・版番号・WebMCPコマンド仕様を、認証不要の読み取り専用MCPから取得します。画像・制作データ・画面IDはMCPへ送信しません。刺繍の編集・計算・出力はブラウザ側で行い、実際の操作には利用環境の対応機能が必要です。取得できない場合は内蔵ガイドを使用し、最新版は未確認と伝えます。

review.commerce_description: The plugin and browser software are free. No purchases or payments are performed by this MCP. External host services and materials may have separate costs.
